card.name: Separators after titles in web listings
card.fires_on: Dash, space, or small connecting word right after a book, article or paper title in web catalog or reference listings, such as publisher lines and download links.

modes.label: Break after a title
modes.description: A dash or space that follows a headline or title and begins the next metadata part.
